scenario: Phishing execution + shadow copy deletion (vssadmin) + LockBit ransomware encryption
summary: On 2026-09-20, user alice on WS-ACCT-01 opened a phishing document invoice_2026-Q3.docx in winword.exe. Word spawned a hidden PowerShell process, which invoked vssadmin.exe to delete shadow copies (/all /quiet) to inhibit system recovery. LockBit ransomware (lockbit.exe, PID 4700) then executed, creating 201 .locked files across Documents and deleting 200 original documents.
kill_chain: 10:05 winword.exe opened invoice_2026-Q3.docx on WS-ACCT-01 (user alice)
10:15 vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet spawned by powershell.exe (inhibit recovery)
10:20 lockbit.exe (PID 4700) encrypted 200+ user documents (.locked extension) and deleted original files
key_iocs: *.locked file creations with original document deletions
evidence_basis: mass file encryption and replacement by lockbit.exe
distractors: Background Office, Chrome, Teams, and Explorer events across WS-ACCT-01, WS-SALES-02, and WS-HR-03.
notes: Evidence gap: the initial execution event for lockbit.exe (PID 4700) is absent from process_started telemetry, but its encryption activity is recorded across 401 file creation and deletion events.
